purpose: Define explicit quarantine of data that fails configured quality gates, preserving original identity/provenance while preventing accidental promotion into accepted operational state.

value.quarantine_rule: Quarantine is an explicit lifecycle/storage state or destination binding.
value.trigger_rule: Entry into quarantine follows an explicit quality gate/profile or authorized manual operation.
value.identity_rule: Quarantined data retains original source identity/provenance and does not become a new semantic owner merely by relocation.
value.accepted_rule: Quarantined data is distinct from accepted operational data.
value.promotion_rule: Promotion/release requires explicit revalidation and authorized acceptance.
value.mutation_rule: Quarantine does not silently repair or rewrite failed data.
value.classification_rule: Security/privacy classification remains in force while quarantined.
value.delete_rule: Quarantine deletion is a separate retention/destruction operation.
